title: Christmas and New Year in Tanzania
excerpt: Spending Christmas and New Year in Tanzania: weather, festivities and booking tips.
body:
## Weather

The short rains are usually over by mid-December. Late December is warm and generally dry, with green landscapes.

## Wildlife

The migration herds move towards the southern Serengeti. Central Serengeti and Ngorongoro are good.

## Celebrations

Many lodges organise a Christmas dinner and New Year's party. In Tanzania, Christmas is celebrated by Christians with church services and family meals.

## Busy

This is peak season. Book very early, flights included.

## Kilimanjaro

See [climbing over Christmas and New Year](/blog/kilimanjaro-new-year-climb/).

## Zanzibar

A beach at New Year is popular; book early.

Read our [December and January page](/safari-in-tanzania-in-december-and-january/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
